notes: Trichomastix Blochmann, 1884 (parabasalid; T. serpentis Dobell) is an obsolete genus now merged into Monocercomonas/Tetratrichomonas; the GBIF backbone's only 'Trichomastix' is an unrelated insect synonym, so no GBIF key is recorded. Treated as an animal by Thompson; not Metazoa in modern taxonomy (see lineage).
